title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Nice Arctic Berries 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Seriously Nice Arctic Berries from Doozy Vape Co. is the perfect e-liquid for anyone who adores authentic fruit flavours with a dash of breezy menthol. Succulent dark and red berries bring waves of tangy, luscious sweetness on the inhale followed by that breezy rush of cool menthol on the exhale for true refreshment. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-liquid go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks .
